entries.name: Windmill Hollow
entries.description: A sleepy seaside village where the captain's journey begins.

entries.name: Garrison Bay
entries.description: A Navy outpost town under a tyrant commander.

entries.name: Carnival Port
entries.description: A harbor seized by a crew of circus pirates.

entries.name: Seawall Village
entries.description: Cliffside farms and a mansion hiding a butler's scheme.

entries.name: The Floating Galley
entries.description: A restaurant ship where cooks fight as hard as they cook.

entries.name: Coral Fortress
entries.description: A reef stronghold of sea-folk raiders oppressing the coast.

entries.name: Gallows Harbor
entries.description: The last port before the Storm Line, haunted by a legendary execution.

entries.name: Twin Peak Current
entries.description: A sea that flows uphill over a mountain into the Storm Line.

entries.name: Lantern Cove
entries.description: A festive town that welcomes pirates a little too warmly.

entries.name: Primeval Isle
entries.description: A jungle where ancient beasts and giant duelists still roam.

entries.name: Frostcrown Isle
entries.description: A snowbound kingdom of tall peaks and a lonely castle.

entries.name: Sunscar Kingdom
entries.description: A desert kingdom drying up under a sand-lord's plot.

entries.name: Rumtide Isle
entries.description: A lawless island of dreamers who believe in cities in the sky.

entries.name: Cloudreach
entries.description: An island of white cloud-seas ruled by a self-declared thunder god.

entries.name: Canal City
entries.description: A shipbuilding metropolis of canals, cranes and secret agents.

entries.name: Iron Tribunal
entries.description: A judicial fortress where the government never sleeps.

entries.name: The Shadow Hulk
entries.description: A gigantic ghost ship drifting through endless fog.

entries.name: Bubble Groves
entries.description: Mangrove islands floating on resin bubbles, crawling with bounty hunters.

entries.name: Abyss Palace
entries.description: A glowing undersea kingdom ten thousand meters down.

entries.name: Burnfreeze Isle
entries.description: Half eternal fire, half eternal ice, and a lab hiding in between.

entries.name: Crimson Coliseum
entries.description: A passionate kingdom held together by a puppet-master's strings.

entries.name: Titan's Back
entries.description: A forest kingdom built on the back of a walking giant.

entries.name: Confection Isles
entries.description: Islands of cake and sugar ruled by a tyrant queen's family.

entries.name: Blossom Shogunate
entries.description: A closed-off land of samurai, cherry blossoms and a dragon warlord.

entries.name: Neon Lab Isle
entries.description: A futuristic island of floating labs, hard-light bridges and rogue androids.
